description: This file defines the InstallerDataRegistrationAPI class, a REST API endpoint controller responsible for handling POST requests related to installer data registration in the OrangeHRM system. It manages registration data submission, state management, and response messaging within the installation workflow.

classes.name: InstallerDataRegistrationAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller extending AbstractInstallerRestController to manage installer data registration processes.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST HTTP requests to perform installer data registration, including state validation, data assembly, registration attempt, and response generation.
